filter_deferred_tools: filter deferred tool schemas from a model request before LLM binding
create_middleware_instance: create a DeferredToolFilterMiddleware instance to intercept model tool binding calls
wrap_model_call: wrap a synchronous model call to remove deferred tools from the request
awrap_model_call: wrap an asynchronous model call to remove deferred tools from the request
get_deferred_registry: get the deferred tool registry to determine which tool schemas to exclude from model binding
